title: GSDIa Disease Monitoring Program
summary: Main objective: Evaluate the long-term safety and pregnancy outcomes of DTX401 in patients with GSDIa
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Patient who had • DTX401 (full or partial dose) administered in a parent clinical study (Group 1)  or • Prescribed DTX401 (full or partial dose) administered in a post-marketing setting (Group 2)
2. Patient is willing and able to provide informed consent after the study has been  explained, and prior to any research-related assessments or procedures. If a minor or an  adult with cognitive limitations, the patient is willing and able (if possible) to provide  assent and have a legally authorized representative provide informed consent after the  nature of the study has been explained, and prior to any research-related assessments or  procedures.
Exclusion criteria:
1. Presence of any condition that would interfere with study participation, interpretation of  results or affect patient’s safety in the opinion of the Investigator

sites.f: University Medical Center Hamburg-Eppendorf – pediatric and adolescent medicine
